bug_semantics: Stored XSS (CWE-79): an authenticated low-privileged user POSTs an HTML payload as post[title] to the drafts create endpoint (DraftsController#create), which assigns params into a draft_child Post and save(validate: false) with no authorize! at 2.9.1. Draft_child rows always carry post_parent, so the admin posts/drafts listing (posts/index.html.erb) renders title via PostDecorator#the_hierarchy_title, which concatenates the unsanitized title and marks the result html_safe. link_to/<%= %> therefore emit raw HTML in an administrator session. Standalone (parent-less) titles in the same table used the_title as an unsafe String and were auto-escaped, which is why ordinary post-title XSS looked patched while parented draft titles were not.
flaw_origin: On 2016-01-17 Owen Peredo committed 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8 ('added page hierarchy support'). That commit first wrote the_hierarchy_title with res.html_safe and switched the admin post/drafts listing from auto-escaped f.the_title to title = f.the_hierarchy_title. The immediate parent 0ee955225a517ea121ed5b3e8029e64fdae07719 has no the_hierarchy_title and lists with link_to f.the_title. The drafts create source (unsanitized title + save(validate: false)) already existed from the 2015 root import, but the listing sink that executes a parented draft title was this hierarchy commit.

reasoning: CVE-2026-73329 is a real published VulnCheck CNA record (not withdrawn/rejected). At 2.9.1 the attack is: low-priv POST to drafts#create stores an HTML title without validation or authorization; because that row is a draft_child with post_parent, the admin drafts listing renders PostDecorator#the_hierarchy_title, which html_safes the unsanitized title, so the administrator's browser executes it. git log -S / parent-tree checks show that listing was auto-escaped via f.the_title until 31f1971504d1b61136bdffdad03cb1a0d16fffb8 first wrote the html_safe helper and wired posts/index.html.erb to it; the parent 0ee95522 lacks those lines. That commit is a single-parent 2016 feature commit, not a merge/squash/revert, and is the smallest public first-write of the executing sink. The drafts save(validate: false) source is older (root 671a7ed1) but was not XSS in the drafts listing until this sink.
